reason: The September 2026 certification update post says AWS Certification is updating three exams and names exactly MLA-C02, SAP-C03 and DVA-C03, so Solutions Architect - Associate is not in that list. The exam guide page title and first sentence name 'AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03)'. The claim says only this and adds no retirement date or other condition.

Under 'Accommodations > English as a second language' the quote says a 30-minute extension is available on request to non-native English speakers taking an exam in English, is named ESL +30, only needs to be requested once prior to registering, and applies to all future registrations with all test delivery providers. Every part of the claim, the scope (exams in English) and the conditions match. The per-exam rule in the context is about disability accommodations, a separate section.

The footnote says the Individual subscription 'starts at $29 USD per month' (a starting price, matching qualifier min). The page says subscribing gives access to Official Practice Exams. The Exam Prep course line with '6-8 hours of practice materials ... and access to the Official Practice Exam' sits under the heading 'Available with a subscription*', so it is the subscription course. The claim adds nothing more.
